topic: How We Teach: Chemical Engineering Electives
title: How We Teach: Chemical Engineering Electives
session_title: Teaching Survey Results and Best Practices: ChE Electives and Process Safety (Invited Talks)
abstract: The Fall 2022 survey by the AIChE Education Division Survey Committee is over chemical engineering electives. The survey will collect information about how many electives are required for chemical engineering undergraduate students. The specific focus is chemical engineering elective courses rather than engineering or science elective courses. We will survey the topics of the offered electives and compare to the results of previous surveys.

title: Process Safety across the Curriculum
session_title: Teaching Survey Results and Best Practices: ChE Electives and Process Safety (Invited Talks)
abstract: The AIChE Education Division Survey Committee is conducting a survey over process safety in the curriculum during spring 2023. Departments have responded to ABET requirements for process safety training in different ways, and these are not necessarily captured by the annual fall surveys over specific courses and the curriculum overall. Questions include where students receive process safety instruction (a single course, multiple courses, other?), what Bloom’s level students are expected to achieve in process safety and management-of-risk outcomes, and usage of various AIChE and other safety resources. Data from AIChE about the popularity of specific SAChE modules will be presented in addition to the survey results so that the departments may gauge themselves against other universities and gain ideas for new safety training.
